properties.method: marked by eye on gridded 4 m crops; scarps checked against 3 m slopes over 15 degrees in the DTM; positions good to a few tens of metres
properties.meaning: visible ice-related landforms: evidence of past ice loss or ice-rich ground, not a measurement of ice today, not a statement on ground strength

properties.name: Scalloped scarp, main terraced margin
properties.d: Terraced, scalloped scarp at a mantle margin: the edge of a depression read as ice loss from the ground beneath (sublimation). Steep 3 m slopes along it in the HiRISE DTM.
properties.method: marked by eye in HiRISE PSP_009467_2225, checked against the HiRISE DTM
